title: backend.rs: define MailBackend trait and error types
description:
Create src/backend.rs with the MailBackend AFIT trait and supporting types. This is the foundational interface that all downstream handlers depend on.

## What to implement

### MailBackend trait (AFIT, not object-safe)
Generic CRUD methods (same pattern as StorageBackend in ~/PROJECT/crate-jmapchat-server/jmapchat-server/src/backend.rs):
- get_objects, changes_objects, query_objects, query_changes_objects
- set_object (create/update/destroy)

Mail-specific methods:
- import_email(account_id, email_ids, mailbox_ids, keywords) -> Result<ImportResult, E>
- parse_email(account_id, blob_id, properties) -> Result<Email, BackendSetError<E>>
- copy_email(from_account, to_account, email_ids) -> Result<CopyResult, E>
- search_snippets(account_id, filter, email_ids) -> Result<Vec<SearchSnippet>, E>

### Error types (new, absent from jmapchat-server)
- BackendSetError<E>: SetError | StorageError(E) — for set operations
- BackendChangesError<E>: AnchorNotFound | StorageError(E) — for changes operations
- ChangesResult: new_state, created, updated, destroyed
- QueryResult: ids, total, position
- QueryChangesResult: old_state, new_state, total, removed, added
- AddedItem: id, index

## Source references
- Copy pattern: ~/PROJECT/crate-jmapchat-server/jmapchat-server/src/backend.rs
- Stalwart trait (AGPL — read, do not copy): ~/GIT/stalwart-jmap-server/main/crates/jmap/src/lib.rs
- RFC 8621 §5 (Email/set), §3 (Mailbox/set), §4 (Thread/get) for method signatures
- jmap-mail-types for Email, Mailbox, Thread, etc. wire types

## Acceptance criteria
- cargo check -p jmap-mail-server passes
- All error types implement std::error::Error via thiserror
- BackendSetError<E> and BackendChangesError<E> are generic over backend storage error
- No unwrap/expect; #[forbid(unsafe_code)] at crate root
- MailBackend is not object-safe (AFIT), doc comment says so
